item.title: [NBC Sports] Adley Rutschman takes seat against Rays
item.dc:creator: Rivers McCown; Adley Rutschman
item.description:
Adley Rutschman is not in Boston’s starting lineup for Friday’s game against the Rays.
It appears to be a routine day off against Rays LHP Ian Seymour. Connor Wong will get the start at catcher after Rutschman played the last six games in a row.
